messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — benchmark blog + short-form case study are set to go live TOMORROW at 10:00 PT. Please read this thread and chime in if you need any changes to quotes or embargo timing.
Mira Patel: Copy — who’s on media standby for the first hour?
Alex Chen: @Leo Gomez will monitor inbox + Slack for journalist replies. @Sophie Li will handle social amplification and quote cards.
Leo Gomez: Confirmed. I’ll be on from 9:45–11:30 PT. Will watch press@ and my inbox.
Sophie Li: I’ll schedule the initial socials + one follow-up 3 hours later. Need final hero image by EOD today please.
Alex Chen: Attached image in drive is the latest: https://drive.redwood/example/bench-hero-v3 (use v3). Small edit: update caption to "Lower latency, lower cost — real workloads."
Mira Patel: Legal flagged one small line in the case study about customer numbers. Can we change "dozens" -> "multiple customers"?
Alex Chen: Done — will update the blog copy now.
press-bot: Reminder: embargo window until 10:00 PT tomorrow. Any early outreach must get sign-off from Mira.
Sophie Li: Quick check — do we want a reactive statement template for reporters asking about comparative numbers? I can draft a 2-sentence response.
Mira Patel: Yes please. Keep it: neutral, factual, and avoid naming competitor pricing. Something like: "Our benchmarks reflect internal workload mixes; contact press@ for full methodology and dataset."
Sophie Li: Drafted and posted in the folder: https://drive.redwood/example/reactive-template — tagging @Leo for approval.
Leo Gomez: Approved. I’ll use that if needed. Also adding a short FAQ paragraph to the blog about methodology.
Alex Chen: Last ops note — during publish window, use Slack thread #press-watch (we’ll mirror threads). If anything urgent, ping @channel and call Mira.
Mira Patel: I’ll be on-call for the first 2 hours after publish. If any embargo breaks or pick-ups require senior comment, I’ll escalate to exec comms.
Sophie Li: All set from social side. Scheduling posts now. :rocket:
Alex Chen: Thanks team — final check-in at 09:30 PT tomorrow in this thread. If no objections by EOD, we proceed with publish at 10:00 PT.
press-bot: Scheduled publish job created: job-id=pb-2024-0612-09. Status=scheduled.
